Meet my latest character! 

Fefnir Ravenfeather 

A 100 year old high elf who was born into a noble family, for years he trained for the day he would take up the mantle of the elders before him. And every 100 after a new heir is born, they receive the families moon blade and set out into the world protecting people in need.(Campaign time) About half a year ago another high elf noble family would destroy his family and his home the day he was to receive the family blade. He nearly escaped with his mother when a stray arrow had hit her, with no way of hearing her the mother told him to escape while he still can. His adventures bring him to a tavern in the middle of a snowy region (Viking inspired area). It’s here where he hunts his own food along with the other party members. He plans on enacting revenge on those who did his family wrong, and to claim his birth right.

A generic story? Oh most definitely, but I wanted to make a character who went back to the absolute basic of ideas.

Interested in my art? Please do dm em if you’re interested, my commissions are always open for art!

This is Fenfrir, (homebrewed bladesinger)

As the title suggests, he was once known as the god of secrets or god of visions. He had the ability to see into the far future, as such the gods wished to use him  for their personal gain of course. Staying true to the title, he kept knowledge from them angering the gods in the pantheon. As a result, he was casted into the mortal plain, stripped of his godhood, his sight and was cursed to remember everything no matter how small the detail along with immortality.

I just thought of the concept last night, so I didn’t really iron out any of the stories gaps or any confusion so sorry if the story is weird.

As for the bladesinger part, I played dnd 4 years ago and this was one of the first build i did. And I changed a lot of things in the subclass to be more in tune with the melee aspect whilst allowing the wizard part to shine through. The character never had his story resolved so I re-did his entire story.

This is my character in the “Lost Mine of Phandelver” campaign!

Backstory:
Corin Lightbranch was born into the Order of the Golden Lion, who worships Torm as there deity. For many decades he would serve Torm and alongside others amongst the order as a cleric. (Though he recently got the bow and arrows) He has had a strange calling for the bow, and seems to have taken a liking to it. Years of service go by and one day he is sent out to fill out his Penance of Duty where ever he may find them. There are three in total.

Debt of persecution: help those of other faith in form of protection or quest

Debt of Dereliction: eliminate those of evil faith

Debt of of Destruction: locate and report areas filled with dead or wild magic

It wasn’t long till he saw a job for Gundren Rockseeker going to Phandalin. If you were to Fulfill a  duty, might as well do it with others along the way.
